thread_analysis.thread_summary: Pi Crystal Corporation (contact Junto Tsurumi) engages Allion (Itsuo Sakai) for Bluetooth SIG registration of a product using the Fanstel BM832 BLE module, spanning April 2025. The thread covers a vendor-confirmed QDID reference combination (no retest needed), Review page confirmation and registration finalization, and the standard Compliance Folder document request cycle.
all_questions_found: Can the customer reference newer QDIDs (tied to a newer SDK version, including a Mesh-capability QDID) instead of the BM832's original QDID, confirmed via direct vendor consultation? (see thread_0031_case_01)

(Administrative, not separately cased) Review page confirmation and registration finalization, and repeated follow-up requests for Compliance Folder documents (operation manual, block diagram, outline drawing, antenna datasheet) -- routine project administration without a generalizable technical lesson.
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The thread's only generalizable technical point is case_01's vendor-confirmation approach to QDID reference changes, demonstrating a clean, low-risk way to validate a new reference combination without requiring retesting.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Proceeding with a new QDID reference combination without the vendor's direct confirmation could risk an invalid registration.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: No consulting-side mistakes identified in the visible record.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Encourage customers proposing a QDID reference change to obtain direct vendor confirmation that the new combination covers their specific hardware before proceeding with registration.
